name: pi-pixie
description: Pixie delegation & command console plugin (dispatch/report/ask/rest/recall/status/interject/stop/retry): talks to the PiAbyss Host loopback control plane; the delegation engine stays Host-side. Post-nap memory is plugin-side: the first turn of a new segment gets an index of past segments plus the previous segment's tail, read straight from Pi's session directory, and pixie_recall reads older segments on demand. Dispatch carries optional taskName/sessionName short names for the host's workspace → session → task delegation list.
author: Nick12138
